video_title: Ajay Mitchell on Playing to the Team's Identity | Postgame Media | November 6, 2026

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on maintaining an aggressive mindset regardless of the opponent
quotes.excerpt: I was just trying to be aggressive out there, see what the defense was going to give us.
quotes.quote: I was just trying to be aggressive out there, see what the defense was going to give us, and just try to play the game. That's really it. Every night is going to be different, so I just go into every game with the same mindset, just going out there and playing and not worried about anything else.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell says his mindset remains consistent regardless of the opponent, focusing on being aggressive and taking what the defense gives him.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell discusses his mindset regarding maintaining aggression on the court regardless of the opponent.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on the team's defensive intensity and identity
quotes.excerpt: We wanted to be aggressive from the jump, be physical, and just be ourselves.
quotes.quote: We wanted to be aggressive from the jump, be physical, and just be ourselves. I think our defense gives us so much energy, and we know on the road we're going to need that. So, going into every game, really that's our mindset is just setting the tone defensively, being aggressive, being physical, and that's our strength.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell emphasizes that the Thunder identity is built on being physical and setting the tone defensively to fuel their energy on the road.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell explains the importance of defensive intensity and physicality to the team's identity.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on how defensive play fuels the offense
quotes.excerpt: It's one of our keys to our offense is just being aggressive on defense.
quotes.quote: It's one of our keys to our offense is just being aggressive on defense and being able to just run, make the simple play, and I think throughout the whole game it just gives us a lot of energy.
quotes.social_post: For Ajay Mitchell, the Thunder offense is fueled by defensive intensity, allowing the team to run and make simple plays.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell describes how defensive play serves as a catalyst for the team's offensive energy.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on the team's depth and offensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: It makes the game easier for all of us.
quotes.quote: It makes the game easier for all of us. Obviously, I think our team, we have so many great players, players that can make play on and off the ball, and I think when you're out there, it makes it a lot easier. So you just go out there, make a simple play, and I think that's really what gets us going.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell credits the depth and versatility of the Thunder roster for making the game easier for everyone on the floor.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell talks about how the team's depth and versatility make the game easier for everyone on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on his defensive development and commitment
quotes.excerpt: In order for me to be on the court, I had to play great defense.
quotes.quote: It just starts with defense. Even when I got here as a rookie, I knew that in order for me to be on the court, I had to play great defense and really bought into that. I like the challenge of being able to guard the best players every night, and it's hard, obviously, but it just makes it challenging and fun, and I love to compete on both ends, so I'm really enjoying that.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell says he knew he had to play great defense to earn minutes as a rookie and he now embraces the challenge of guarding the best players every night.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell reflects on his commitment to defensive development since joining the team as a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on his offseason work and training habits
quotes.excerpt: A lot of great work in the offseason, shout out my guy Luke.
quotes.quote: A lot of great work in the offseason, shout out my guy Luke, but then also just the work that I put in every day. Our training staff has been amazing, just every day being able to get my work in, and then the rest is just playing basketball and having fun. For me, it makes it easier. It makes my job easier. I know all I have to do is show up and put the work in.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell attributes his development to offseason work and the consistency of the training staff, saying he just focuses on showing up and putting the work in.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell credits his offseason work and the team's training staff for his current performance.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on maintaining confidence through shooting slumps
quotes.excerpt: I know the amount of work I put in, so when I go out there and it's not falling, I'm not worried.
quotes.quote: I think just staying confident no matter what's going on. I know the amount of work I put in, so when I go out there and it's not falling, I'm not worried. I'm really focused on just helping this team win, and every possession matters. So for me, it's like trying to move on really quick to the next one, no matter if shots are going or not, and that's really been my mindset these past two years, so I try to keep it like that.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell on dealing with shooting slumps: I know the amount of work I put in, so when it is not falling I am not worried. I am focused on helping this team win.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell explains how he maintains confidence and focus on winning even when his shots are not falling.
